inferences: No source road has a usable width tag in the modeled crop. Tagged lanes inform estimated widths, not a surveyed carriageway extent.

White dashed lane separators and a subdued single central separation line follow actual road direction. Paint dimensions and center-line convention are inferred rather than directly measured in the facade photos.
Drain grates use photo-supported slotted form but estimated 18m spacing, not mapped utilities.
Existing promenade railing/lamp shapes and spacing remain v3 photo-proportioned estimates.
No new trees: canopy fragments do not establish trunk coordinates, and fetched crop contains no mapped tree.
